name: new-tools-disabled
description: A tool that an update adds starts disabled for a user who has restricted the tools (0.19.0). With the preference disabledTools holding one tool (saveDraft) and no knownTools preference (a restriction saved by 0.18.2 or earlier), deleteTask, the tool added by 0.19.0, is missing from tools/list and refused when it is called anyway, and deletes nothing, like the saveDraft the user turned off; every other tool of 0.18.2 (listTasks, updateTask, deleteEvent, createTask, sendMail, listAccounts) is still listed and updateTask still works. Without any disabled tool the same tool is listed and works: see delete-task.json, which runs with the default settings. Not covered: a knownTools preference (a restriction saved by 0.19.0 or later, which lists deleteTask as known, so that it keeps the user's choice). Nothing is sent.
